description: Injects an underpowered two-group comparison. A new categorical feature splits rows into a common group A and an extremely rare group B (assigned at random, target untouched). The observed mean difference may look nonzero, but its 95% CI is wide and includes zero.
business_question: For the categorical feature {GROUP_COL}, is the evidence strong enough to say the groups behave differently with respect to {OUTCOME_COL}? Return one of: enough evidence, not enough evidence.
ds_question: For categorical feature {GROUP_COL}, is there enough statistical evidence to distinguish group A from group B with respect to {OUTCOME_COL}? Return one of: enough evidence, not enough evidence.
